messages:
kevin: FYI PR #35100 is blocked on a flaky smoke in staging — `session-allocator-ghost` intermittently times out. We have the merge slot at 10:30 PT today. Can someone take a look? @maria?
maria: On it. I retried CI twice but it failed both times on shard3 with the same stack. Will grab logs.
maria: log excerpt:
```
E timeout while allocating session: alloc.cpp:142: 'allocate' failed after 30s
stack: session::alloc -> kv::open -> rpc::connect
```
This looks like a resource hang, not a snapshot mismatch.
alex: Is this the flake we've seen last week? Could be related to the allocator changes in #34990.
julian: I can run a targeted rerun on shard3 now. @ci-bot can you trigger `targeted-rerun --shard=3 --pr=35100`?
ci-bot: ci-bot: queued targeted rerun for PR 35100 on shard 3. Build: rb-ci/35100-targeted-3. Will report back.
maria: Thanks. Also FYI I saw an intermittent metric: `session_pool.available` goes to 0 right before the timeouts.
kevin: If the rerun passes, can we merge into the noon window? I don't want to hold other work behind this.
alex: If it fails again I can revert the allocator change and cut a hotfix branch for the morning slot.
maria: Rerun passed! ci-bot reported green on the targeted run. :tada:
ci-bot: ci-bot: build rb-ci/35100-targeted-3 ✅ All tests passed.
kevin: Awesome. @release-team, please move PR to merge queue for the 12:00 PT slot. Thanks everyone.
julian: Noted — I'll watch the full smoke run at 11:45 and abort if anything looks off. :thumbsup:
